messages:
zoe: FYI CS reported a customer seeing doubled quota after adding x-redwood-project to requests with org-scoped keys.

jin: ugh, this again. repro?

zoe: minimal repro from staging:

```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer sk_org_abc,
  x-redwood-org: org_acme,
  x-redwood-project: proj_sidecar
}
```

Console shows two series and sums them.

alex: root cause = telemetry emitting both owner and token_origin series and Console aggregates naively.

sam: quick mitigation: pipeline should emit owner_canonical = project:proj_sidecar when project header present, else org:org_acme, else legacy:key. Console rollup must prefer owner_canonical for totals. token_origin can be emitted as debug only.

jin: agree. plan: canary pipeline change + console flag for 48h. billing will use billing_view=compat for invoices during migration.

observability-bot: muted alert 'quota-dup' until 1707850000 by zoe.

zoe: I'll open PRs and add a short runbook note for CS. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
